title: Enjoy what you have earned
literal_meaning: If you have earned it, eat boldly.
meaning_odia: ନିଜେ ଅର୍ଜନ କରିଥିଲେ ତାହାକୁ ସଂକୋଚ ନକରି ଭୋଗ କରିବାର ସାହସ ଥାଏ—କଥାଟିକୁ ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ ରୋଜଗାରରୁ ଆସୁଥିବା ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Earning comes first; confident enjoyment follows. ଗରଜି brings the force of a roar into the invitation to eat, giving it a bold, assertive tone. This edition reads it as confidence in enjoying one’s own earnings, rather than a literal instruction to make noise at a meal.
usage_example: After being paid for work, someone hesitates to buy a modest treat. A friend might recall this saying to encourage them to enjoy what they have earned. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ଅରଜି and ଗରଜି make a close sound pair, linking earning with assertiveness. Eating gives the general idea of enjoying resources a concrete image. The line does not specify a profession, income level or particular meal.

witnesses.locator: Inspected public page line 124, beginning ଅରଜି ଥିଲେ.
